name: text-loop
title: Text Loop
description: Uppercase words and star separators run endlessly along a thick wavy ribbon, with a second pale ribbon crossing it at an angle. The text loops without a seam and slows when hovered.
use: A hero or divider needs a wide moving band of repeated words to add energy without images.
avoid: Constant motion cannot be paused except on hover, and long uppercase text can feel loud on quiet pages.
a11y: The strip is a labelled image with no pause button or keyboard control; motion stops under reduced motion. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A wide dark band with a vivid blue-violet ribbon and a pale lavender ribbon crossing in opposite diagonals, both following a wave. Bold uppercase white letters with star separators ride the ribbons.
behaves: The words slide along both ribbons in opposite directions, wrapping with no visible seam. Hovering eases the movement to a stop, and with dragging enabled the strip can be pulled and flung.
customise: Text, shape or custom SVG path, speed, direction, separator, font size, colours, ribbon width, edge fade, cross ribbon and dragging are props.
weight: light: A ticker moves two text paths; no layout or canvas work.
demo: Uppercase "Design systems ✦ Motion ✦ Interfaces" repeated along the ribbons.
polishWhy: High-impact crossing ribbons; cut-off letters at the edges look accidental without a fade.
